dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL; uses // delimiters in COPY REPLACING, INDEXED files with DYNAMIC access, no EXEC SQL/CICS
evidence: ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED / ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC
no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS, no COMP-3

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) comment editing subsystem within the JMA ORCA medical billing system
purpose.summary: ORCR0040 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that handles comment editing (コメント編集) for medical insurance receipts. It reads and writes multiple indexed receipt data files (RECE02, RECE04, RECE05 and work variants), processes various medical billing comment types (rehabilitation, oxygen therapy, drug reduction, etc.), and writes error records to an error file.

notable_features: 41 COPY statements with REPLACING using // delimiters (GnuCOBOL style)
Multiple INDEXED files with DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access modes
577 PERFORM statements indicating complex structured logic
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (latin-1 decoded as mojibake)
Extensive revision history in comments spanning 2002–2009
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese text (appears as mojibake). This is the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt software, well-known in Japanese healthcare IT. The // COPY REPLACING delimiter style is characteristic of GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL. Source is truncated at 16000 chars but enough structure is visible for confident classification.
